paragraphs: Posted by Lily. Chef Lucy came to our school for a cooking class. Each pupil got an instruction sheet from her. She taught us for two hours, and we were very hungry. We cooked barbecue chicken in a pan, because the school has no place for a fire. This is a good indoor recipe, and here are the steps. An adult must stand next to the stove at all times.

First, check the ingredients. You need four pieces of chicken, three cloves of garlic, and two spoons of honey. You also need two spoons of soy sauce and a little oil. Get a bowl, a pan, a brush, and a pair of tongs. Put all the things on the table before you start. Check that the pan is clean and dry. Wash your hands, and tie your hair back. Then tie an apron around your waist.

Next, make the sauce. An adult cuts the garlic into very small pieces. Put the garlic, the honey, and the soy sauce in the bowl. Mix the sauce with a spoon for one minute. Use the spoon and not your fingers. The sauce smells sweet and strong. Then put the chicken in the bowl, and turn each piece in the sauce. Leave the bowl in a cool place for twenty minutes.

After that, cook the chicken. The adult heats the pan and puts in a little oil. The adult uses the tongs to put the chicken in the pan. The adult cooks it for five minutes, and then turns each piece. Then the adult brushes a little more sauce on top. Do not touch the hot pan, and stand back when the oil jumps. The adult cooks it for ten more minutes, and then cuts one piece to check the middle. The inside must be white, and no part may be pink.

Then make the dessert while the chicken rests. An adult cuts two bananas in half and puts them in a clean pan. The adult adds a spoon of honey on each banana. The adult cooks them for three minutes, and then turns them once. The bananas are soft, so the adult turns them slowly. The dessert is ready when the bananas are brown.

Finally, put the chicken and the dessert on clean plates. Wash your hands again, and say thank you to the adult who helped you. Chef Lucy told us, "Clean plates make food taste better." Which part of this recipe do you like best?
